science2.lead: What the calculations are based on and how far you can trust them. Everything below is real test results, not tuned.
science2.plainTables: The calculator and the AI agent compute gas from reference tables in the literature (KTBL 2025, FNR) — the main source of the numbers.
science2.plainMae: We also trained an ML model on 619 laboratory tests. On average it is off by ±{v0} mL of methane per gram of organic matter. Typical yields in these tests are 300–500 mL/g, so the error is about 10–20 %.
science2.plainTest: On the held-out test the error is larger — ±{v0} mL/g, and the model explains only {v1} % of the spread. That is not enough for a precise forecast, and we say so.
science2.plainUse: That is why the ML model is the research part of the project: it is not used in the calculations for the farmer.
science2.maeExplain: The model's average error is ±{v0} mL/g — so for a yield of 400 mL/g the model may say up to {v0} mL/g less or {v0} mL/g more.
science2.testExplain: On the held-out laboratories the error is ±{v0} mL/g and R² = {v1} % — the model catches only a small part of the differences between tests.

rx.nolink.piText: No readings, the buttons are inactive. The laptop looks for the Pi via the Pi's Wi-Fi, the cable and a shared network. When the laptop is silent for more than 15 s, the Pi switches off the relays switched on from the laptop; the Arduino's automatic mode keeps working.
rx.nolink.arduinoText: The Raspberry Pi gets no data from the Arduino over USB. After 10 s without a link the Arduino switches off the relays switched on from the Pi; its protection and automatic mode work without the Pi.

rx.reset.none: No alarm needs a reset. E-STOP is also on the Arduino itself: hold the BACK button for 2 s.
rx.alarm.estopLead: Every relay is off, the automatic mode is off.
rx.alarm.estop: Stays until a person resets it: the «Reset alarms» button or holding the encoder button for 3 s on the Arduino. Switch the automatic mode on again after the reset.
rx.alarm.leakLead: The Arduino switched every relay and the automatic mode off.
rx.alarm.leakText: Outside sensor: {value} (raw value), limit {limit}. Ventilate the room, no open fire.
rx.leak.still: The gas outside is still above the limit — no reset yet.
rx.leak.gone: The gas outside is below the limit. A person resets the alarm.
rx.alarm.overheat: The temperature reached {limit} °C: the heater is off and locked until it cools by 2 °C.
rx.alarm.no_temp: The DS18B20 (pin 28) does not answer: the heater is off and locked.
rx.alarm.link_lost: 10 s without commands from the Pi: the Arduino switched off the relays switched on from the laptop. «Reset alarms» clears the mark.
rx.alarm.laptop_lost: The laptop was silent for more than 15 s: the Pi switched off the relays switched on from the laptop. The Arduino's automatic mode was not touched.
rx.alarm.auger_timeout: The auger ran for more than 10 minutes without a break — the Arduino switched it off.
rx.alarm.warmup: 60 s after the Arduino started: heater and pump are locked, leaks are not checked yet.

rx.note.rh: DHT11; attention from 95 % (condensate on the sensor)

rx.note.gasOut: MQ-9 outside, raw signal (not ppm); above {limit} — leak alarm, every relay off

rx.mode.title: Arduino automatic mode
rx.mode.autoText: The Arduino keeps the temperature between the limits and runs the pump when there is much gas inside.
rx.mode.manualText: Only a person switches the heater, cooling and pump.
rx.who.byArduino: switched on at the Arduino (automatic mode or a button)
rx.reason.leak: locked: gas leak — reset the alarm first
rx.reason.warmup: wait: the gas sensors are warming up (60 s after start)
rx.reason.no_temp: locked: the temperature sensor does not answer
rx.reason.overheat: locked: overheating, wait until it cools by 2 °C
rx.reason.interlock: not allowed: heater and cooling at the same time
rx.reason.gas_still_high: the gas outside is still above the limit — the leak cannot be reset
rx.reason.out_of_range: limit out of range (Temp Min ≤ Temp Max − 0.5; Overheat ≥ Temp Max + 2; gas 50–1000)
rx.reason.local_edit: someone is editing the limits on the Arduino screen — try later
rx.reason.bad_args: the Arduino did not understand the command's parameters
rx.reason.no_ack: the Arduino did not answer in time
rx.reason.unknown: the Arduino did not understand the command, or the reason is unknown
rx.done.reset: Alarms reset. Switch the automatic mode on again if needed.
rx.done.estop: EMERGENCY STOP: the Arduino switched everything off.
rx.done.autoOn: The Arduino's automatic mode is on
rx.confirm.on.heat: The heater starts warming the reactor. The Arduino's automatic mode switches off. The Arduino switches the heater off itself on overheating, a leak or a sensor fault.
rx.confirm.on.cool: Cooling starts lowering the temperature. The Arduino's automatic mode switches off.
rx.confirm.on.pump: The pump starts drawing gas out of the reactor. The Arduino's automatic mode switches off.
rx.confirm.on.auger: The auger (motor) starts turning. Make sure no hands are near it. The Arduino switches it off after 10 min of continuous running.
rx.confirm.offText: The relay will be switched off.
rx.confirm.resetText: Reset only if the cause is gone: no gas outside, the installation was checked. A leak is not reset while the gas outside is above the limit.
rx.confirm.autoOnTitle: Switch the Arduino's automatic mode on?
rx.confirm.autoOnText: The Arduino will switch the heater, cooling and pump by its own limits. Relays switched on from the laptop come under its control.
rx.confirm.autoOffText: From now on only a person switches the heater, cooling and pump. The Arduino's protection keeps working.
rx.confirm.limitText: Was {was}, becomes {value}. The limit is saved in the Arduino's memory (EEPROM) and works without the laptop too.
rx.limits.title: Arduino limits
rx.limits.lead: Kept in the Arduino's memory (EEPROM), the same as in the Limits menu on its screen. Only a person changes them, with confirmation.
rx.limits.unknown: The limits have not come from the Arduino yet.
rx.limit.temp_minHint: automatic mode: heater below this temperature
rx.limit.temp_hard_maxHint: the heater always switches off; at least Temp Max + 2 °C, up to 70 °C
rx.limit.gas_out_limitHint: raw MQ-9 value (50–1000); set it in clean air
rx.limit.gas_in_limitHint: raw MQ-9 value (50–1000); above it the automatic mode runs the pump
rx.sim.title: Simulator: test the protection without hardware
rx.sim.lead: The same Raspberry Pi code and a virtual Arduino with the rules of firmware bioreactor-1.0 run inside the dashboard. The buttons below simulate faults.
rx.journalLead: Kept on the Raspberry Pi (SQLite): time, what happened, who did it and the result.
rx.journalStale: No link with the Pi: the log is not updated.
rx.j.auger_timeout: Auger switched off by time (10 min)
rx.j.arduino_lost: Alarm: no data from the Arduino
rx.j.arduino_boot: Arduino started (relays off, automatic mode on)
rx.j.no_boot_line: The Arduino sent no boot line
rx.chain.title: How the installation and its protection work
rx.chain.sensorsText: DS18B20, DHT11, two MQ-9; relays: heater, cooling, pump, auger
rx.chain.arduinoText: screen, automatic mode and the main protection — works without the Pi
rx.chain.usbText: 115200 baud: a JSON status every second, PING / RELAY / SET commands
rx.chain.piText: bridge: PING every 2 s, log, laptop watchdog
rx.chain.networkText: the Pi's Wi-Fi hotspot or an Ethernet cable, no internet
rx.chain.agentText: reads the readings and advises, switches nothing
rx.chain.safety: Arduino protection: leak → every relay off and an alarm until reset; overheating or no sensor → heater off; 60 s MQ warm-up; heater and cooling never together; 10 s without the Pi → what the Pi switched on goes off; auger no longer than 10 min. Laptop silent 15 s → the Pi switches off what the laptop switched on. E-STOP: the button here or BACK for 2 s on the Arduino.
rx.noLinkButton.hint: Button inactive: no link with the installation
rx.estop.noLink: no link with the installation — hold BACK on the Arduino for 2 s
rx.j.time_set: Pi clock set from the laptop
ov.methaneSub: range {v0}–{v1} m³ · demo reactor: {v2} L cattle slurry, {v3} days
